Sec. 2. The unrestricted immigrant and nonimmigrant entry into the United 
States of aliens determined to meet one or more of the criteria in subsection 
1(a) of this order would be detrimental to the interests of the United States, 
and the entry of such persons into the United States, as immigrants or 
nonimmigrants, is therefore hereby suspended. Such persons shall be treated 
as persons covered by section 1 of Proclamation 8693 of July 24, 2011 
(Suspension of Entry of Aliens Subject to United Nations Security Council 
Travel Bans and International Emergency Economic Powers Act Sanctions). 
Sec. 3. I hereby determine that the making of donations of the type of 
articles specified in section 203(b)(2) of IEEPA (50 U.S.C. 1702(b)(2)) by, 
to, or for the benefit of any person whose property and interests in property 
are blocked pursuant to section 1 of this order would seriously impair 
my ability to deal with the national emergency declared in Executive Order 
13692, and I hereby prohibit such donations as provided by section 1 of 
this order. 
Sec. 4. The prohibitions in section 1 of this order include: 
(a) the making of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services 
by, to, or for the benefit of any person whose property and interests in 
property are blocked pursuant to this order; and 
(b) the receipt of any contribution or provision of funds, goods, or services 
from any such person. 
Sec. 5. (a) Any transaction that evades or avoids, has the purpose of evading 
or avoiding, causes a violation of, or attempts to violate any of the prohibi-
tions set forth in this order is prohibited. 
(b) Any conspiracy formed to violate any of the prohibitions set forth 
in this order is prohibited. 
Sec. 6. For the purposes of this order: 
(a) the term ‘‘person’’ means an individual or entity; 
(b) the term ‘‘entity’’ means a partnership, association, trust, joint venture, 
corporation, group, subgroup, or other organization; 
(c) the term ‘‘United States person’’ means any United States citizen, 
lawful permanent resident, entity organized under the laws of the United 
States or any jurisdiction within the United States (including foreign 
branches), or any person in the United States; 
(d) the term ‘‘Government of Venezuela’’ means the Government of Ven-
ezuela, any political subdivision, agency, or instrumentality thereof, includ-
ing the Central Bank of Venezuela, and any person owned or controlled 
by, or acting for or on behalf of, the Government of Venezuela. 
Sec. 7. For those persons whose property and interests in property are 
blocked pursuant to this order who might have a constitutional presence 
in the United States, I find that because of the ability to transfer funds 
or other assets instantaneously, prior notice to such persons or to the Govern-
ment of Venezuela of measures to be taken pursuant to this order would 
render those measures ineffectual. I therefore determine that for these meas-
ures to be effective in addressing the national emergency declared in Execu-
tive Order 13692, there need be no prior notice of a listing or determination 
made pursuant to section 1 of this order. 
Sec. 8. The Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary 
of State, is hereby authorized to take such actions, including promulgating 
rules and regulations, and to employ all powers granted to the President 
by IEEPA as may be necessary to implement this order. The Secretary 
of the Treasury may, consistent with applicable law, redelegate any of these 
functions within the Department of the Treasury. All agencies of the United 
States Government shall take all appropriate measures within their authority 
to carry out the provisions of this order. 
Sec. 9. The Secretary of State is hereby authorized to take such actions, 
including the promulgation of rules and regulations, and to employ all 
powers granted to the President by IEEPA, the INA, and section 5 of the

- **ACT:EO:11858>EO:12661**; S69e2b9bb143a00f9b96df559; {"actor_id":"EO:12661","char_end":6188,"char_start":6030,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3587,"char_start":3167,"text":"Pursuant to section 2443 of the Omnibus Trade Act and subject to the exceptions referred to in paragraph (3), departments, agencies and instrumentalities of the United States Government shall not for the three-year period beginning on the date this Order takes effect, contract with or procure products and services from Toshiba Machine Company, Kongsberg Trading Company, Toshiba Corporation or Kongsberg Vaapenfabrikk."},{"char_end":4097,"char_start":3773,"text":"Pursuant to section 2443 of the Omnibus Trade Act and subject to the exceptions referred to in paragraph (3), importation into the United States, its territories and possessions, of products produced by Toshiba Machine Company or Kongsberg Trading Company is prohibited for three years from the effective date of this Order."},{"char_end":9508,"char_start":9217,"text":"(G) The Interim Presidential Directive to the Secretary of the Treasury of October 26, 1988, is hereby revoked, and any notices received or investigations pending as of the date this Order takes effect shall be referred to the Chairman of the Committee for action consistent with this Order."},{"char_end":18459,"char_start":18260,"text":"The heads of Executive departments and agencies shall, to the extent permitted by law, provide the Director with such information as may be necessary for the effective performance of these functions."},{"char_end":19111,"char_start":19096,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":19187,"char_start":19112,"text":"This Order shall take effect at 12:01 a.m. on Wednesday, December 28, 1988."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:11858>EO:12661","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. - **ACT:EO:11858>EO:12661@bb84efb94bd40aa9**; S69e2b9bb143a00f9b96df559; {"actor_id":"EO:12661","char_end":6188,"char_start":6030,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":3587,"char_start":3167,"text":"Pursuant to section 2443 of the Omnibus Trade Act and subject to the exceptions referred to in paragraph (3), departments, agencies and instrumentalities of the United States Government shall not for the three-year period beginning on the date this Order takes effect, contract with or procure products and services from Toshiba Machine Company, Kongsberg Trading Company, Toshiba Corporation or Kongsberg Vaapenfabrikk."},{"char_end":4097,"char_start":3773,"text":"Pursuant to section 2443 of the Omnibus Trade Act and subject to the exceptions referred to in paragraph (3), importation into the United States, its territories and possessions, of products produced by Toshiba Machine Company or Kongsberg Trading Company is prohibited for three years from the effective date of this Order."},{"char_end":9508,"char_start":9217,"text":"(G) The Interim Presidential Directive to the Secretary of the Treasury of October 26, 1988, is hereby revoked, and any notices received or investigations pending as of the date this Order takes effect shall be referred to the Chairman of the Committee for action consistent with this Order."},{"char_end":18459,"char_start":18260,"text":"The heads of Executive departments and agencies shall, to the extent permitted by law, provide the Director with such information as may be necessary for the effective performance of these functions."},{"char_end":19111,"char_start":19096,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":19187,"char_start":19112,"text":"This Order shall take effect at 12:01 a.m. on Wednesday, December 28, 1988."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:11858>EO:12661@bb84efb94bd40aa9","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; - **ACT:EO:11858>EO:13286**; Sd3145c7b44424f882132e4cb; {"actor_id":"EO:13286","char_end":34935,"char_start":34819,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"unknown","effective_date":null,"effective_wording":[{"char_end":2501,"char_start":2411,"text":"Executive Order 13260 of March 19, 2002, is hereby revoked effective as of March 31, 2003."},{"char_end":41701,"char_start":40943,"text":"(a)\nin the case of the Department of Defense, the Secretary of Defense has, after consideration of the authority provided under subtitle G of title VIII of the Homeland Security Act of 2002, determined that the exercise of authority under this order is necessary for the timely and effective conduct of United States military or intelligence activities; and\n(b)\nin the case of any other executive department or agency that has authority under this order, (i) the Secretary of Homeland Security has advised whether the use of the authority provided under subtitle G of title VIII of the Homeland Security Act of 2002 would be appropriate, and (ii) the Director of the Office and Management and Budget has approved the exercise of authority under this order.\"."},{"char_end":49577,"char_start":49526,"text":"This order shall become effective on March 1, 2003."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:11858>EO:13286","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Effective wording is ambiguous, section-specific, or has no determinable date.","provision_label":"Sec. 57.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":["Without prejudice to subsections (a) through (i) of this section, all responsibilities assigned to specific Federal officials pursuant to Executive Order 12656 that are substantially the same as any responsibility assigned to, or function transferred to, the Secretary of Homeland Security pursuant to the Homeland Security Act of 2002 (regardless of whether such responsibility or function is expressly required to be carried out through another official of the Department of Homeland Security or not pursuant to such Act), or intended or required to be carried out by an agency or an agency component transferred to the Department of Homeland Security pursuant to such Act, are hereby reassigned to the Secretary of Homeland Security.","Executive Order 11239 of July 31, 1965 (\"Enforcement of the Convention for Safety of Life at Sea, 1960\"), as amended, is further amended, without prejudice to section 1–106 of Executive Order 12234 of September 3, 1980 (\"Enforcement of the Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea\"), by:","Savings Provision."],"scope":"partial","signing_date":"2003-02-28","target_id":"EO:11858","verb":"amend"}

  Text: [T024e6298b717c545cb37a499](#t024e6298b717c545cb37a499); absolute characters 2710–3169
- **ACT:EO:13658>EO:14026**; S80c8e95f0072d0348ab3d780; {"actor_id":"EO:14026","char_end":8308,"char_start":8151,"confidence":"medium","effective_class":"on_signing","effective_date":"2021-04-27","effective_wording":[{"char_end":3529,"char_start":2990,"text":"The amount shall be published \nby the Secretary at least 90 days before such new minimum wage is \nto take effect and shall be: \n(A) not less than the amount in effect on the date of such determination; \n(B) increased from such amount by the annual percentage increase in \nthe Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers \n(United States city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted), or its \nsuccessor publication, as determined by the Bureau of Labor Statistics; \nand \n(C) rounded to the nearest multiple of $0.05."},{"char_end":4337,"char_start":3531,"text":"(b) In calculating the annual percentage increase in the Consumer Price \nIndex for purposes of subsection (a)(ii)(B) of this section, the Secretary \nshall compare such Consumer Price Index for the most recent month, quarter, \nor year available (as selected by the Secretary prior to the first year for \nwhich a minimum wage is in effect pursuant to subsection (a)(ii)(B) of \nthis section) with the Consumer Price Index for the same month in the \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 16:10 Apr 29, 2021 Jkt 253001 PO 00000 Frm 00001 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\30APE0.SGM 30APE0jbell on DSKJLSW7X2PROD with EXECORD\n=== PDF page 2 of 4 ===\n22836 Federal Register / Vol. 86, No. 82 / Friday, April 30, 2021 / Presidential Documents \npreceding year, the same quarter in the preceding year, or the preceding \nyear, respectively."},{"char_end":5197,"char_start":4625,"text":"(a) For workers covered under section \n2 of this order who are tipped employees pursuant to section 3(t) of the \nFair Labor Standards Act of 1938 (29 U.S.C. 203(t)), the cash wage that \nmust be paid by an employer to such workers shall be at least: \n(i) $10.50 per hour, beginning January 30, 2022; \n(ii) beginning January 1, 2023, 85 percent of the wage in effect under \nsection 2 of this order, rounded to the nearest multiple of $0.05; and \n(iii) beginning January 1, 2024, and for each subsequent year, 100 percent \nof the wage in effect under section 2 of this order."},{"char_end":7122,"char_start":6631,"text":"(b) Within 60 days of the Secretary issuing regulations pursuant to sub-\nsection (a) of this section, agencies shall take steps, to the extent permitted \nby law, to exercise any applicable authority to ensure that contracts and \ncontract-like instruments as described in sections 8(a)(i)(C) and (D) of this \norder, entered into on or after January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective \ndate of such agency action, comply with the requirements set forth in \nsections 2 and 3 of this order."},{"char_end":11051,"char_start":11036,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":11925,"char_start":11052,"text":"(a) This order is effective immediately and shall \napply to new contracts; new contract-like instruments; new solicitations; \nextensions or renewals of existing contracts or contract-like instruments; \nand exercises of options on existing contracts or contract-like instruments, \nas described in section 8(a) in this order, where the relevant contract or \ncontract-like instrument will be entered into, the relevant contract or contract- \nlike instrument will be extended or renewed, or the relevant option will \nbe exercised, on or after: \n(i) January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective date for the action \ntaken by the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council pursuant to section \n4(a) of this order; or \n(ii) for contracts where an agency action is taken pursuant to section \n4(b) of this order, January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective date \nfor such action."},{"char_end":12710,"char_start":11927,"text":"(b) As an exception to subsection (a) of this section, where agencies \nhave issued a solicitation before the effective date for the relevant action \ntaken pursuant to section 4 of this order and entered into a new contract \nor contract-like instrument resulting from such solicitation within 60 days \nof such effective date, such agencies are strongly encouraged but not required \nto ensure that the minimum wages specified in sections 2 and 3 of this \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 16:10 Apr 29, 2021 Jkt 253001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\30APE0.SGM 30APE0jbell on DSKJLSW7X2PROD with EXECORD\n=== PDF page 4 of 4 ===\n22838 Federal Register / Vol. 86, No. 82 / Friday, April 30, 2021 / Presidential Documents \norder are paid in the new contract or contract-like instrument."},{"char_end":13551,"char_start":13004,"text":"(c) For all existing contracts and contract-like instruments, solicitations \nissued between the date of this order and the effective dates set forth \nin this section, and contracts and contract-like instruments entered into \nbetween the date of this order and the effective dates set forth in this \nsection, agencies are strongly encouraged, to the extent permitted by law, \nto ensure that the hourly wages paid under such contracts or contract- \nlike instruments are consistent with the minimum wages specified in sections \n2 and 3 of this order."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13658>EO:14026","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. Express signing-date wording; supplied signing date still needs source confirmation.","provision_label":"Sec. 6.","reaches_target_via":"","savings_phrases":[],"scope":"whole","signing_date":"2021-04-27","target_id":"EO:13658","verb":"revoke"}

and"},{"char_end":4172,"char_start":4045,"text":"(iii) beginning January 1, 2024, and for each subsequent year, 100 percent of the wage in effect under section 2 of this order."},{"char_end":6072,"char_start":5588,"text":"(b) Within 60 days of the Secretary issuing regulations pursuant to subsection (a) of this section, agencies shall take steps, to the extent permitted by law, to exercise any applicable authority to ensure that contracts and contract-like instruments as described in sections 8(a)(i)(C) and (D) of this order, entered into on or after January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective date of such agency action, comply with the requirements set forth in sections 2 and 3 of this order."},{"char_end":9691,"char_start":9676,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":10223,"char_start":9692,"text":"(a) This order is effective immediately and shall apply to new contracts; new contract-like instruments; new solicitations; extensions or renewals of existing contracts or contract-like instruments; and exercises of options on existing contracts or contract-like instruments, as described in section 8(a) in this order, where the relevant contract or contract-like instrument will be entered into, the relevant contract or contract-like instrument will be extended or renewed, or the relevant option will be exercised, on or after:"},{"char_end":10391,"char_start":10225,"text":"(i) January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective date for the action taken by the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council pursuant to section 4(a) of this order; or"},{"char_end":10553,"char_start":10393,"text":"(ii) for contracts where an agency action is taken pursuant to section 4(b) of this order, January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective date for such action."},{"char_end":11065,"char_start":10555,"text":"(b) As an exception to subsection (a) of this section, where agencies have issued a solicitation before the effective date for the relevant action taken pursuant to section 4 of this order and entered into a new contract or contract-like instrument resulting from such solicitation within 60 days of such effective date, such agencies are strongly encouraged but not required to ensure that the minimum wages specified in sections 2 and 3 of this order are paid in the new contract or contract-like instrument."},{"char_end":11893,"char_start":11354,"text":"(c) For all existing contracts and contract-like instruments, solicitations issued between the date of this order and the effective dates set forth in this section, and contracts and contract-like instruments entered into between the date of this order and the effective dates set forth in this section, agencies are strongly encouraged, to the extent permitted by law, to ensure that the hourly wages paid under such contracts or contract-like instruments are consistent with the minimum wages specified in sections 2 and 3 of this order."}],"exceptions_text":["to the extent it is inconsistent with this order"],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13658>EO:14026@2222acf39527670e","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; \n(B) increased from such amount by the annual percentage increase in \nthe Consumer Price Index for Urban Wage Earners and Clerical Workers \n(United States city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted), or its \nsuccessor publication, as determined by the Bureau of Labor Statistics; \nand \n(C) rounded to the nearest multiple of $0.05."},{"char_end":4337,"char_start":3531,"text":"(b) In calculating the annual percentage increase in the Consumer Price \nIndex for purposes of subsection (a)(ii)(B) of this section, the Secretary \nshall compare such Consumer Price Index for the most recent month, quarter, \nor year available (as selected by the Secretary prior to the first year for \nwhich a minimum wage is in effect pursuant to subsection (a)(ii)(B) of \nthis section) with the Consumer Price Index for the same month in the \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 16:10 Apr 29, 2021 Jkt 253001 PO 00000 Frm 00001 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\30APE0.SGM 30APE0jbell on DSKJLSW7X2PROD with EXECORD\n=== PDF page 2 of 4 ===\n22836 Federal Register / Vol. 86, No. 82 / Friday, April 30, 2021 / Presidential Documents \npreceding year, the same quarter in the preceding year, or the preceding \nyear, respectively."},{"char_end":5197,"char_start":4625,"text":"(a) For workers covered under section \n2 of this order who are tipped employees pursuant to section 3(t) of the \nFair Labor Standards Act of 1938 (29 U.S.C. 203(t)), the cash wage that \nmust be paid by an employer to such workers shall be at least: \n(i) $10.50 per hour, beginning January 30, 2022; \n(ii) beginning January 1, 2023, 85 percent of the wage in effect under \nsection 2 of this order, rounded to the nearest multiple of $0.05; and \n(iii) beginning January 1, 2024, and for each subsequent year, 100 percent \nof the wage in effect under section 2 of this order."},{"char_end":7122,"char_start":6631,"text":"(b) Within 60 days of the Secretary issuing regulations pursuant to sub-\nsection (a) of this section, agencies shall take steps, to the extent permitted \nby law, to exercise any applicable authority to ensure that contracts and \ncontract-like instruments as described in sections 8(a)(i)(C) and (D) of this \norder, entered into on or after January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective \ndate of such agency action, comply with the requirements set forth in \nsections 2 and 3 of this order."},{"char_end":11051,"char_start":11036,"text":"Effective Date."},{"char_end":11925,"char_start":11052,"text":"(a) This order is effective immediately and shall \napply to new contracts; new contract-like instruments; new solicitations; \nextensions or renewals of existing contracts or contract-like instruments; \nand exercises of options on existing contracts or contract-like instruments, \nas described in section 8(a) in this order, where the relevant contract or \ncontract-like instrument will be entered into, the relevant contract or contract- \nlike instrument will be extended or renewed, or the relevant option will \nbe exercised, on or after: \n(i) January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective date for the action \ntaken by the Federal Acquisition Regulatory Council pursuant to section \n4(a) of this order; or \n(ii) for contracts where an agency action is taken pursuant to section \n4(b) of this order, January 30, 2022, consistent with the effective date \nfor such action."},{"char_end":12710,"char_start":11927,"text":"(b) As an exception to subsection (a) of this section, where agencies \nhave issued a solicitation before the effective date for the relevant action \ntaken pursuant to section 4 of this order and entered into a new contract \nor contract-like instrument resulting from such solicitation within 60 days \nof such effective date, such agencies are strongly encouraged but not required \nto ensure that the minimum wages specified in sections 2 and 3 of this \nVerDate Sep<11>2014 16:10 Apr 29, 2021 Jkt 253001 PO 00000 Frm 00003 Fmt 4790 Sfmt 4790 E:\\FR\\FM\\30APE0.SGM 30APE0jbell on DSKJLSW7X2PROD with EXECORD\n=== PDF page 4 of 4 ===\n22838 Federal Register / Vol. 86, No. 82 / Friday, April 30, 2021 / Presidential Documents \norder are paid in the new contract or contract-like instrument."},{"char_end":13551,"char_start":13004,"text":"(c) For all existing contracts and contract-like instruments, solicitations \nissued between the date of this order and the effective dates set forth \nin this section, and contracts and contract-like instruments entered into \nbetween the date of this order and the effective dates set forth in this \nsection, agencies are strongly encouraged, to the extent permitted by law, \nto ensure that the hourly wages paid under such contracts or contract- \nlike instruments are consistent with the minimum wages specified in sections \n2 and 3 of this order."}],"exceptions_text":[],"filing_date":null,"id":"ACT:EO:13658>EO:14026@9f70ab72f013444f","names_target":true,"notes":"Machine lead only; no legal ending or revival asserted. ## Valla review leads and component attestations

Review lead only. Every case needs separate applicability, earlier-ending, scope, independent-command, savings and independent whole-case review.
Preparation attestations never approve legal conclusions or replace whole-case review.

verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"The Federal Government shall provide leadership  \nin preserving, restoring and maintaining the historic and cultural en­\nvironment of the Nation."},{"char_end":2137,"char_start":1275,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2137,"context_char_start":1275,"line":21,"pdf_page":7,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory; verify its scope against the complete source pages.","signals":["shall"],"text":"Agencies of the executive branch of the Govern­\nment (hereinafter referred to as “Federal agencies” ) shall (1) administer  \nthe cultural properties under their control in a spirit of stewardship and  \ntrusteeship for future generations, (2) initiate measures necessary to  \ndirect their policies, plans and programs in such a way that federally  \nowned sites, structures, and objects of historical, architectural or archaeo­\nlogical significance are preserved, restored and maintained for the in­\nspiration and benefit of the people, and (3),  in consultation with the  \nAdvisory, Council on Historic Preservation (16 U.S.C. 470i), institute  \nprocedures to assure that Federal plans and programs contribute to the  \npreservation and enhancement of non-federally owned sites, structures  \nand objects of historical, architectural or archaeological significance."},{"char_end":2312,"char_start":2186,"classification":"clause_candidate","context_char_end":2312,"context_char_start":2186,"line":33,"pdf_page":7,"reason":"Command-like sentence has substantive text outside submitted inventory;
